data.title: Add Paused status for bugs
data.body:
## Goal

Add a `Paused` status for bugs that are intentionally set aside.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Add `Paused` variant to `Status` enum
- [ ] `docket pause ID` transitions InProgress → Paused
- [ ] `docket resume ID` transitions Paused → InProgress
- [ ] Paused bugs are hidden from default `docket list` (like Done)
- [ ] `docket list --paused` or `--all` shows paused bugs
- [ ] Optionally store a reason: `docket pause ID --reason "switching to higher priority"`

## Context

Different from Blocked: Paused is an intentional choice to set work aside, Blocked is waiting on external factors. Paused bugs aren't actively being worked on but aren't abandoned either.
